newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas says int'l share up in August.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas says int'l share up in August.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Wednesday it carried 40.3 percent of international passengers travelling into and out of Australia in August, a rise of 0.4 percentage points over the August 1995 level.
Qantas said that according to Department of Transport figures its share of the market increased for the second successive month and was 1.5 percent higher than in July 1996.
The airline said passenger numbers were 9.2 percent higher than for August 1995 and ahead of 8.3 percent growth in the overall international airline market into and out of Australia for August 1996.
Qantas carried 445,920 passengers into and out of Australia in August 1996 compared with 408,233 a year ago.
By 3.35 p.m. (0435 GMT), Qantas shares were two cents higher at A$2.02 on turnover of 2.43 million shares.
